blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.
  We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.
  We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.
blocks.zh:
世界模型和世界行动模型分别侧重于未来的世界预测和可执行的行动生成. 虽然这些模型从所包含轨迹中学习了共同的物理动力学和相互作用语义学,但它们通常被隔离训练,这限制了预测和控制之间的知识再利用. 因此,主要的挑战是建立一个统一的学习框架,分享这些动态,同时保持每个范式所要求的独特的建模能力。
我们提出UniW(A)M,一种以扩散变形器为基础的专家世界(行动)混合模型,它统一了行动条件的世界模型和各种WAM变体。 共享的专家捕捉到共同的动态,而原子能力专家则被跨接口再利用,以便每个接口保持自己的有条件路径. 在部署时,一个插入适应性接口路由器(PAIR)从一个小子集的目标任务块设想中学习,为每个执行块选择合适的WAM接口,平衡任务成功和执行效率,同时使主干被冻结.
在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三项现实世界操纵任务上,我们评价UniW(A)M,它取得了88.3%的实际世界平均成功率,而最强基线为76.7%。 在WorldArena上,它领导着以行动为条件的世界在所有三项任务上的模式化. AC-WM共同培训有助于在每个行动界面上产生行动,而PAIR将OD成功率从63.3%提高到76.7%。

blocks.en: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) offer complementary capabilities for embodied intelligence: predicting how environments evolve and generating actions to interact with them ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Action-conditioned world models simulate future observations given candidate actions ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , whereas WAMs use future-world representations to support action generation ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . WAM variants differ in how they use visual prediction, ranging from explicit or latent future modeling ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) to action-only inference that omits future-video generation at deployment ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 世界模型(WMs)和世界行动模型(WAMs)为体现的智能提供了互补能力:预测环境如何演变和产生与它们互动的行动(Wang等人,2026年b). 有行动条件的世界模型模拟了未来给定的候选行动(Guo等人,2025年),而WAMs则利用未来世界的表示来支持行动生成(Shen等人,2026年). WAM的变体在如何使用视觉预测上有所不同,从明确或潜在的未来模型(Sun等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年)到在部署时省略未来-视频生成的仅行动推论(Yean等人,2026年a).

blocks.en: Existing unified models connect world prediction and action generation through shared generative modeling and modular architectures. Motus integrates understanding, video-generation, and action experts ( Bi et al., 2025 ) , while UWM couples video and action diffusion to support multiple prediction modes ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Worldscape-MoE extends shared dynamics learning to heterogeneous action controls ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Together, these approaches demonstrate the value of shared modeling and modular specialization. For jointly trained video–action interfaces, the key design issue is how to reuse shared dynamics while organizing specialized computation around the predictive roles induced by different conditional dependencies.
blocks.zh: 现有的统一模型通过共享基因模型和模块架构将世界预测和行动生成联系起来. Motus融合了理解、视频生成和行动专家(Bi等人,2025年),而UWM夫妇的视频和行动传播则支持多种预测模式(Zhu等人,2025年)。 Worldscape-MoE将共享动态学习扩展至多种动作控制(Fang等人,2026年)。 这些方法共同显示了共享模式和模块化专业化的价值。 对于联合培训的视频-行动接口,关键的设计问题是如何重新利用共享的动态,同时围绕不同条件依赖性引发的预测作用组织专门的计算。

blocks.en: Building on this direction, we jointly train action-conditioned world modeling and multiple WAM interfaces so that world modeling contributes to action generation and each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. These interfaces define different conditional relationships over the same embodied trajectories: future actions may be supplied as conditions or generated as outputs, and future video and action tokens interact under different visibility patterns. Video–action masks make these dependencies explicit within a common modeling framework.
blocks.zh: 在这个方向上,我们联合训练了具备行动条件的世界模型和多个WAM接口,以便世界模型有助于行动生成,每个接口都保留自己的有条件路径. 这些界面定义了不同的条件关系,相对于同一包含的轨迹:未来行动可能作为条件提供或作为产出产生,未来视频和行动符号在不同的能见度模式下相互作用. 视频-动作口罩使这些依赖性在共同的建模框架内明确.

blocks.en: We propose UniW(A)M , a mixture-of-experts framework that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and four WAM interfaces within a shared diffusion Transformer. Video–action visibility masks specify each interface’s conditional dependencies. We organize the interfaces around four reusable predictive roles, which we term atomic capabilities: action-free video prediction, direct action generation, action-conditioned video prediction, and video-conditioned action generation. Shared experts model common dynamics, while atomic capability experts specialize in these roles and can be reused across interfaces. To align expert computation with these roles, Capability-Aligned Token Routing ( CATR ) assigns video and action target groups to eligible expert sets and learns mixture weights within each set. Joint training on the same trajectory data allows the interfaces to reuse these components while retaining their distinct conditional pathways.
blocks.zh: 我们提议UniW(A)M,即一个专家混合框架,统一行动条件的世界模型,并在一个共享的传播变形器内设置四个WAM接口。 视频 - 动作可见度口罩指定每个接口有条件的依赖性 。 我们围绕四个可重复使用的预测作用组织接口,我们称之为原子能力:无动作视频预测,直接动作生成,有动作条件的视频预测,以及有影像条件的动作生成. 共享专家模拟共同动态,而原子能力专家则专门研究这些作用,可以跨接口重复使用。 为了使专家的计算与这些角色保持一致,Capability-Accessed Token Routing(CATR)将视频和行动目标群体分配给合格的专家集,并在每集中学习混合权重. 就同一轨迹数据进行联合培训,使接口能够再利用这些组件,同时保留其独特的有条件途径。

blocks.en: These WAM interfaces differ in their use of future-video prediction and inference cost, raising a deployment question: which interface should be used at each execution chunk? The Plug-in Adaptive Interface Router ( PAIR ) learns this selection offline from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios while keeping the UniW(A)M backbone frozen. At deployment, PAIR uses the current embodied context to select one of the four WAM interfaces for each chunk, allowing execution to switch between fast action-generation pathways that omit future-video prediction and interfaces that explicitly predict future video as interaction demands change.
blocks.zh: 这些WAM接口在使用未来-视频预测和推论成本方面有所不同,引发了一个部署问题:每个执行块应该使用哪个接口? Plug-indeptive 接口路由器(PAIR)从一个小子集的目标任务块情景中学习此选择,同时保持 UniW(A)M 骨干冻结. 在部署时,PAIR使用当前已包含的上下文为每个块选择四个WAM接口中的一个,允许执行在省略未来视频预测的快速动作生成路径和明确预测未来视频的界面之间切换,因为互动需要改变.

blocks.en: On three real-world manipulation tasks, UniW(A)M achieves 88.3% average success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline, and leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three WorldArena tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to every action interface, including those that do not predict future video at deployment, and CATR keeps all four interfaces effective under joint training. Under distribution shifts, PAIR raises average success from 63.3% to 76.7% by selecting the interface for each chunk while the backbone stays frozen.
blocks.zh: 在三个现实世界的操纵任务上,UniW(A)M在最强基线上取得了88.3%的平均成功率,而76.7%的平均成功率,并领导了所有三个世界阿雷纳任务上的行动条件世界模型. AC-WM联合培训为每个动作界面做出贡献,包括那些在部署时不预测未来视频的接口,CATR将所有四个接口都保持有效,接受联合培训. 在分配转移时,PAIR通过为每块选择接口,将平均成功率从63.3%提高到76.7%。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We introduce UniW(A)M , a mixture-of-experts framework that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and four WAM interfaces through video–action visibility masks. Shared dynamics experts, atomic capability experts, and CATR enable joint training while each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. • We develop PAIR for chunk-level WAM interface selection, adapting interface choice using a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios without updating the shared backbone, raising OOD success and improving execution efficiency. • Experiments show that co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and that the unified model leads action-conditioned world prediction, and that PAIR further raises OOD success by selecting the interface per chunk with the backbone frozen.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:我们介绍UniW(A)M,这是一个专家混合框架,通过视频-行动能见度口罩,统一了行动条件的世界模型和四个WAM接口。 共享动力学专家、原子能力专家和CATR使联合培训成为可能,而每个接口则保持自己的有条件路径。 我们开发了用于块级WAM接口选择的PAIR,在不更新共享主干线,提高OD成功率和提高执行效率的情况下,使用一小部分目标任务块方案来调整接口选择. • 实验显示,共同培训有助于在每个行动界面上产生行动,统一模式导致有行动条件的世界预测,PAIR通过选择每块与主干冻结的接口进一步提高OD成功率。

Shared dynamics experts, atomic capability experts, and CATR enable joint training while each interface keeps its own conditional pathway.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Action-conditioned world models (AC-WMs) represent a branch of world models (WMs) dedicated to embodied robotic planning and evaluation ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Built primarily upon large-scale pre-trained video generative models, they simulate future temporal evolution conditioned on current observations and specified actions ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wu & Gao, 2026 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ) . Unlike pure policy models, AC-WMs emphasize controllable action dependencies and focus primarily on future world prediction rather than joint optimization with action generation ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Shang et al., 2026 ) . However, the general dynamics knowledge acquired through action-conditioned world modeling is rarely transferred to world action models, which limits overall data efficiency ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 具备行动条件的世界模型(AC-WMs)是世界模型的一个分支,致力于体现机器人规划和评价(Lu等人,2026年)。 主要以大规模预先训练的视频基因模型为基础,模拟以当前观测和特定行动为条件的未来时间演化(Guo等人,2025年;Wu & Gao,2026年;Bruce等人,2024年)。 与纯政策模型不同的是,AC-WMs强调可控动作依赖性,主要关注未来世界预测,而不是与动作生成联合优化(Shen等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Shang等人,2026年). 然而,通过行动条件世界模型化获得的一般动态知识很少被转移到世界行动模型中,这限制了总体数据效率(Sun等人,2026年;Tang等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年b).

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) integrate future world prediction and executable action generation within a unified learning objective, enabling action synthesis to exploit foresight into future states. Existing WAM variants differ in their generation targets and conditional structures ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Specifically, joint interfaces predict video and actions concurrently ( Ye et al., 2026b ) , visual-to-action interfaces synthesize visual futures prior to inferring actions ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and action-centric interfaces prioritize action output during inference while treating video primarily as a supervisory signal ( Ye et al., 2026a ) . Although these variants rely on identical embodied trajectory data, their conditional dependencies, implemented via attention masks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , vary considerably. Current methodologies typically train and deploy a single interface in isolation, which prevents the specialized action-generation capabilities developed across different interfaces from being shared and reused within a unified model ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型将未来的世界预测和可执行的行动生成纳入一个统一的学习目标,使行动综合能够利用展望未来国家。 现有的WAM变体在生成目标和条件结构上有所不同(Shen等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年). 具体来说,联合接口同时预测视频和行动(Ye等人,2026b),视觉对行动接口在推断行动前合成视觉未来(Li等人,2026b),以行动为中心的接口在推论中优先考虑动作输出,同时将视频主要作为监督信号处理(Ye等人,2026a). 虽然这些变体依赖于相同的内含轨迹数据,但其有条件的依赖性是通过注意罩实现的(Wang等人,2026a; 彭等,2026年;赵等,2026年;罗等,2026年),相差很大. 目前的方法通常在孤立的情况下培训和部署单一的接口,从而阻止在统一模型内共享和再利用跨越不同接口开发的专门行动生成能力(Sun等人,2026年;Tang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures, exemplified by Motus ( Bi et al., 2025 ; Motubrain Team et al., 2026 ) , integrate understanding, video generation, and action experts into a single framework, enabling flexible switching across multiple operational modes through coordinated scheduling. Another line of research employs a single Transformer backbone ( Mei et al., 2026 ) , represented by UWM and UniWM, where UWM couples video and action diffusion via independent diffusion timesteps to facilitate flexible transitions among diverse modes ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , while UniWM unifies planning and visual imagination within a multimodal autoregressive backbone ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . A third direction adopts Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, such as Worldscape-MoE ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , which captures universal world dynamics via shared experts and processes heterogeneous control signals with condition-specific experts, thereby achieving modular disentanglement and scaling under multimodal action supervision. Nevertheless, the mutual reinforcement among distinct modes within such unified frameworks to improve overall model performance remains largely unexplored ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Motus(Bi等人,2025年;Motubrain Team等人,2026年)为例的Mixture-of-Transfors(MOT)架构,将理解,视频生成,以及行动专家整合到一个单一的框架之中,通过协调的调度,能够灵活地跨越多个业务模式进行切换. 另一条研究线使用单一的变形器主干线(Mei等人,2026年),以UWM和UniWM为代表,其中UWM夫妇通过独立传播时间步骤进行视频和行动传播,以促进不同模式之间的灵活过渡(Zhu等人,2025年),而UniWM统一了多式联运主干线内的规划和视觉想象(Dong等人,2025年)。 第三个方向采用 " 专家混合 " 架构,如 " 世界景观 " (Fang et al., 2026;Shen et al., 2026),通过共享的专家和处理与特定条件专家的异质控制信号,捕捉世界普遍动态,从而在多模式行动监督下实现模块化分离和规模化。 然而,在这种统一框架内不同模式之间的相互加强,以改善总体模式业绩,基本上仍未加以探讨(Lu等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: UniW(A)M jointly trains action-conditioned world modeling and four WAM interfaces on shared embodied trajectories, so that world modeling contributes to action generation while each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. Its design has three components. First, we formulate action-conditioned world modeling and four WAM variants as interfaces defined by video-action visibility masks, making their distinct conditional dependencies explicit within a unified framework. Second, these interfaces share a diffusion Transformer backbone and are jointly trained on the same trajectory data. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while CATR assigns each video and action token group to the experts of its predictive role. Third, PAIR selects one of the four WAM interfaces for each execution chunk. With the backbone frozen, it learns this selection from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios, switching between fast action pathways and interfaces that predict future video under OOD conditions.
blocks.zh: UniW(A)M联合在共享的内含轨迹上训练行动条件世界模型和四个WAM接口,这样,世界模型在每一个接口保持自己的有条件路径的同时,都有助于动作生成. 它的设计有三个组成部分. 首先,我们制定有行动条件的世界模型和四个WAM变体,作为视频动作能见度口罩定义的接口,使其独特的有条件的依赖关系在一个统一的框架中明确. 其次,这些接口共享一个扩散变形器主干线,并共同接受相同轨迹数据的培训. 共享的专家捕捉到共同的动态,而CATR则将每个视频和行动符号组指派给其预测作用的专家. 第三,PAIR为每个执行块选择四个WAM接口中的一个. 随着骨干被冻结,它从一个小子集的目标任务块情景中学习到这个选择,在快速动作路径和预测未来在OOD条件下的视频的界面之间切换.

blocks.en: We define four atomic capabilities: VGM , action-free video prediction; VLA , direct action generation; WM , action-conditioned video prediction; and IDM , video-conditioned action generation. VGM and WM model the future world, whereas VLA and IDM model future actions. These capabilities organize predictive roles within our chosen interfaces. Each expert receives the representation admitted by that interface’s attention mask, and the role name refers to this masked prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们定义了四个原子能力:VGM,无动作视频预测;VLA,直接动作生成;WM,动作有条件视频预测;以及IDM,视频有条件动作生成. VGM和WM模拟未来世界,而VLA和IDM模拟未来行动. 这些能力在我们所选择的界面内组织预测作用. 每个专家都收到该接口的注意罩所承认代表,角色名称指的是这个蒙蔽的预测.

blocks.en: Joint-WAM combines the video-prediction role of VGM with the video-conditioned action-prediction role of IDM, motivated by decomposing a joint video–action distribution into a video marginal and an action conditional, as in DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . The two modalities are denoised jointly with bidirectional attention, allowing their evolving representations to inform one another. IDM-WAM uses the same VGM and IDM capabilities with a sequential dependency. VGM first predicts a visual rollout, and IDM then infers actions conditioned on that rollout. Action tokens can access the predicted future video, while future video tokens do not attend to future actions. Action-Centric-WAM combines VLA and WM: VLA predicts actions without accessing future video, while WM predicts their visual consequences as auxiliary training supervision. Action-Only-WAM combines VLA and VGM with both directions of future cross-modal attention disabled, so the two branches predict their respective targets from the observed context. Both interfaces omit future-video prediction at deployment. AC-WM activates WM to predict future observations given candidate actions. These actions are clean external conditions rather than prediction targets, so the interface supports world simulation without generating executable actions.
blocks.zh: 例如DreamZero(Ye等人,2026b)中, 联合WAM将VGM的视频预测角色与IDM的视频设定动作预测角色结合起来, 这两种模式是双向联合宣布的,允许它们不断变化的表述方式相互通报。 IDM-WAM使用相同的VGM和IDM能力,并依次依赖. VGM首先预言一个视觉的推出,IDM然后推断以该推出为条件的行动. 动作符可以访问预言的未来视频,而未来的视频符则不会关注未来的行动. Action-Centric-WAM结合了VLA和WM:VLA在不访问未来视频的情况下预测动作,而WM则预测其视觉后果作为辅助训练监督. Action-Only-WAM将VLA和VGM与未来跨模式关注的双方向结合在一起,因此这两个分支从观察到的背景中预测各自的目标. 这两个接口在部署时都省略了未来-视频预测. AC-WM激活WM来预测未来给定的候选行动观察. 这些行动是干净的外部条件而不是预测目标,因此界面支持世界模拟而不产生可执行的行动.

blocks.en: 3.2 Architecture of UniW(A)M
blocks.zh: 3.2 UniW(A)M建筑

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , UniW(A)M uses interface-specific attention masks and replaces the diffusion Transformer’s dense feed-forward sublayers with mixture-of-experts modules, initialized from the pretrained dense sublayers as described in Appendix G.3 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,UniW(A)M使用特定接口的注意罩,并用专家混合模块取代扩散变形器密集的饲料前向子层,这些模块从附录G.3所述的预先训练的密集子层中初始化。

blocks.en: Shared experts participate in every interface, while atomic experts specialize in interface-specific predictive roles. The same expert ensemble can support different interfaces through distinct attention masks. Training and inference expert assignments are detailed in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 共享的专家参与每个接口,而原子专家则专门研究接口特有的预测作用. 同样的专家综艺可以通过独特的关注面具支持不同的界面. 附录A.4详述了培训和推断专家的任务。

blocks.en: We introduce Capability-Aligned Token Routing (CATR) to align expert computation with the predictive roles of video and action token groups. Each target group is assigned a prescribed set of eligible experts based on its modality and interface-specific predictive role. A learned router produces group-level mixture weights within this set; experts outside the set do not contribute to the group’s output. Tokens within a group share these weights but retain their individual expert outputs. Video target groups use VGM or WM specialists, whereas action target groups use VLA or IDM specialists, alongside shared experts. The eligible sets and treatment of clean conditions are detailed in Appendix A.4 . Guided by CATR, UniW(A)M is jointly optimized through the multi-task training objective detailed in Appendix G.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们推出Capability-Acontrol Token Routing(CATR),使专家的计算与视频和动作符号组的预测作用一致. 根据其模式和具体接口的预测作用,为每个目标群体指定了一组合格专家。 学习的路由器在本集内产生组级混合物权重;该集外的专家不为组级产出做出贡献. 一组内的托肯人分享这些权重,但保留其个人专家产出。 视频目标群体使用VGM或WM专家,而行动目标群体使用VLA或IDM专家,同时使用共享专家. 合格成套清洁条件和处理方法详见附录A.4。 在CATR的指导下,UniW(A)M通过附录G.2详述的多任务培训目标共同优化.

blocks.en: IDM-WAM generates video and actions sequentially, whereas Joint-WAM denoises them jointly. Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM omit future-video prediction and use shared and VLA experts for action denoising. Their conditioning paths differ: WM is inactive in Action-Centric-WAM, while Action-Only-WAM additionally uses VGM for the initial conditioning frame, allowing different contextual representations and action predictions. Detailed expert assignments and cache handling are provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: IDM-WAM依次生成视频和动作,而联合WAM则联合曝光. Action-Centric-WAM和Action-Only-WAM省略了未来影视预测,并使用共享的VLA专家进行行动解析. 它们的调制路径不同:WM在Action-Centric-WAM中不活动,而Action-Only-WAM在初始调制框中额外使用VGM,允许不同的上下文表示和行动预测. 详细的专家任务和缓存处理载于附录A.4。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: To ensure fair and reproducible comparisons, we evaluate models under the same task settings and protocols, covering future-world modeling and action generation. During unified training, we sample the five paradigms uniformly and optimize one paradigm per step. We evaluate action generation on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and three real-world tasks: cloth folding, box folding, and tabletop cleaning (Figure 3 ). AC-WM’s action-conditioned video prediction is evaluated with WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) . Further details on the benchmarks and evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix C .

We measure the trade-off between task execution capability and inference cost for each interface. Figure 5 (b) reports full action-chunk inference time divided by the configured step count of 16: Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM require 154.3 ms and 225.8 ms, respectively, whereas Joint-WAM and IDM-WAM require 428.1 ms and 532.7 ms. blocks.en: Removing AC-WM from mixed training reduces success across all four WAM interfaces on all three tasks. Average success decreases by 15.0 percentage points for both Joint-WAM and IDM-WAM, and by 31.7 and 43.3 points for Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM, respectively. The larger drops on Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM show that AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation even on interfaces that do not predict future video at deployment. Detailed results are provided in Appendix G.4 .
blocks.zh: 将AC-WM从混合训练中移除会减少所有四个WAM接口在所有三项任务上的成功. 联合水机制和国际水机制的平均成功率分别下降了15.0%和31.7%和43.3个百分点。 Action-Centric-WAM和Action-Only-WAM的较大下降显示,AC-WM的协同培训甚至有助于在部署时无法预测未来视频的界面上产生行动. 详细结果见附录G.4。

blocks.en: We compare a single dense DiT initialized from Wan2.1-I2V-14B ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) with joint UniW(A)M training under the same training steps, learning-rate settings, and data volume; the detailed results are reported in Appendix G.4 . All four interfaces of the jointly trained UniW(A)M substantially outperform the baseline, whose best success rate is only 16.7%, whereas UniW(A)M achieves 88.3%.
blocks.zh: 将Wan2.1-I2V-14B(Team Wan et al.,2025年)初始化的单一密集二T与在相同的培训步骤、学习率设置和数据量下的联合UniW(A)M培训进行比较;详细结果见附录G.4。 联合培训的UniW(A)M的所有四个接口都大大超过基线,其最佳成功率仅为16.7%,而UniW(A)M则达到88.3%。

blocks.en: The two MoE configurations have identical expert counts, network structures, and parameter counts. They differ in routing organization: sample-level routing applies the active expert ensemble to the entire sample, whereas CATR assigns eligible expert sets and learned mixture weights to modality- and role-specific token groups. This restricts specialist FFN computation to the relevant groups while retaining shared attention and shared experts. As shown in Appendix G.4 , sample-level routing produces uneven performance: Joint-WAM and IDM-WAM achieve 51.7% and 60.0% average success, respectively, whereas both Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM achieve only 10.0%. With expert count and parameter count held fixed, CATR improves all four interfaces and raises Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM from 10.0% to 81.7% and 80.0%, so joint training delivers all four interfaces.
blocks.zh: 两个MOE配置都有相同的专家计数,网络结构,参数计数. 它们在路由组织上各有不同:样本级路由将活跃的专家组合应用于整个样本,而CATR则将合格的专家组合和所学得的混合物权重分配给模式和角色特定标志组. 这限制了专家FFN的计算,同时保留了共同的注意力和共同的专家。 如附录G.4所示,抽样一级的路线性能不均匀:联合-WAM和IDM-WAM分别取得了51.7%和60.0%的平均成功率,而行动-Centric-WAM和Action-Only-WAM都只取得了10.0%的成功率. 随着专家计数和参数计数固定,CATR改进了所有四个接口,并将Action-Centric-WAM和Action-Only-WAM从10.0%提高到81.7%和80.0%,因此联合培训提供所有四个接口.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: UniW(A)M unifies action-conditioned world modeling and four WAM interfaces through video–action masks and capability-aligned expert routing. Experiments demonstrate action generation and future-world prediction within a shared backbone. Ablations show that AC-WM co-training improves all four WAM interfaces across three real-world tasks, while CATR improves action generation relative to sample-level routing. PAIR further improves OOD execution through chunk-level interface selection with the backbone frozen. Together, these results support joint learning and adaptive deployment of complementary world and action modeling capabilities.
blocks.zh: UniW(A)M通过视频-动作口罩和能力相适应的专家路由,统一行动条件的世界模型和四个WAM接口. 实验表明,在共同的主干线内,行动产生和未来世界的预测。 缩写显示AC-WM协同训练改进了跨越三个现实世界任务的所有四个WAM接口,而CATR则相对于样本级路由改进了动作生成. PAIR通过与主干冻结的块级接口选择,进一步改善OOD执行. 这些成果共同支持共同学习和适应性地部署互补的世界和行动建模能力。

blocks.en: A.3 Trajectory Organization and Teacher Forcing
blocks.zh: A.3 轨迹组织和教师强化

blocks.en: The unified training configuration draws all five interfaces from the same trajectory-window format: 33 RGB frames, 96 action vectors, four robot states, and a language instruction. Video encoding produces nine temporal latent frames, comprising an initial condition and four successive blocks of two future latent frames. Each block is aligned with 24 actions and one state. The language instruction enters through cross-attention. AC-WM uses the aligned video and action data but does not include state tokens in its Transformer input.
blocks.zh: 统一训练配置从相同的轨迹-窗口格式中抽取所有五个接口:33个RGB帧,96个动作矢量,4个机器人状态,以及1个语言指令. 视频编码产生九个时间潜伏框架,包括一个初始条件和两个未来潜伏框架的连续四个块. 每个区块与24个动作和1个状态一致. 语言教学通过交叉注意进入. AC-WM使用对齐的视频和动作数据,但不在其变形器输入中包括状态符号.

blocks.en: Table 5 distinguishes conditioning copies from prediction targets. Clean video copies provide observed history for teacher forcing; they are not additional prediction targets. For Joint-WAM and the full-window Action-Centric-WAM, Action-Only-WAM, and AC-WM paths, a target block accesses the clean video prefix preceding that block, together with the current-block inputs permitted by its interface mask. This prevents the clean copy of the target future video from becoming a direct input to its own prediction. IDM-WAM instead follows an interleaved video-then-action ordering: the current video condition precedes the action target, allowing action denoising to use that video while preventing the reverse dependence. Its video-condition augmentation is described in Appendix G.2 .

blocks.en: A.4 Capability-Aligned Token Routing
blocks.zh: A.4 能力相匹配的托肯列车

blocks.en: Figure 11 summarizes the expert groups used by each interface in the two execution settings. The shared component is retained throughout, whereas the active atomic groups depend on which modalities are predicted and what they condition on. At inference, Action-Centric-WAM uses shared and VLA experts; WM is inactive because no future video is generated. Action-Only-WAM additionally retains VGM to process the initial conditioning-frame tokens, while future action tokens use shared and VLA experts. Its separate conditioning-frame expert path is retained even when future-video prediction is removed. This design preserves specialized visual conditioning within the interface’s separation of future video and action targets; information leakage from future targets is prevented by the visibility mask, not by expert activation alone. blocks.en: CATR combines a prescribed expert eligibility set with learned mixing weights. Each MoE feed-forward sublayer contains one shared expert and four atomic experts, VGM, VLA, WM, and IDM. In the real-robot PAIR server, an interface change clears the model’s runtime caches and resets window tracking. The newly selected interface is seeded from the latest frame of the current observation, rebuilding its cache through its own computation path; KV entries from the previous interface are not transferred. If the interface remains unchanged, normal within-interface caching continues, subject to its window resets.

blocks.en: Joint-WAM pools the current block’s video, action, and state representations, then applies separate eligibility masks for video and action groups. IDM-WAM pools each video or action target group separately. The full-window Action-Centric-WAM, Action-Only-WAM, and AC-WM paths likewise pool each predicted modality within its block. These representations already incorporate the context allowed by attention; the router does not pool the entire trajectory indiscriminately. CATR therefore specifies expert computation inside the selected interface, whereas PAIR selects the action-generating interface at deployment. The two routing mechanisms operate at different levels.
blocks.zh: 联合WAM将当前区块的视频、动作和州立代表联合起来, IDM-WAM将每个视频或行动目标群体单独集合. 完全窗口行动-Centric-WAM,行动-Only-WAM,以及AC-WM路径同样将每个预言模式集合在其块内. 这些表述已经包括了注意允许的背景;路由器不会不分青红皂白地汇集整个轨迹。 因此,CATR在选定的接口内指定专家计算,而PAIR则在部署时选择动作生成接口. 两种途径机制在不同层面运作。

blocks.en: B.1 MAE-Based Training Targets
blocks.zh: B.1 基于千年生态系统评估的培训目标

blocks.en: The OOD adaptation datasets comprise human-collected demonstrations of the same three real-world tasks: Folding Clothes, Folding Box, and Tabletop Cleaning. Each episode records camera observations and the corresponding robot actions throughout task execution. These demonstrations are separate from the data used to train the backbone: the task goals are shared, but the object instances and scene conditions differ, including lighting and object appearance such as color. Task-specific shifts include garment colors and sizes, box types, and cluttered backgrounds, as defined in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: OOD适应数据集包括由人收集的关于同样三个现实世界任务的演示:折叠衣物、折叠盒和表顶清洁。 每集记录了相机观察以及整个任务执行过程中相应的机器人动作. 这些演示与用来训练主干线的数据是分开的:任务目标共享,但对象实例和场景条件不同,包括照明和颜色等对象外观. 具体任务的变化包括服装颜色和大小、箱型以及第4.1节定义的杂乱背景。

blocks.en: For each target task, we randomly select 500 episodes from its OOD dataset and construct candidate chunk scenarios using a sliding window of 24 consecutive action steps with stride one action step, aligned with the execution chunk length. We then randomly sample 2,000 chunk scenarios from this candidate pool. Each scenario is evaluated by all four frozen WAM interfaces, producing 8,000 interface-specific action predictions per task. The reference action chunk is the recorded action sequence from the corresponding window in the OOD dataset, not an action sequence generated by any of the four interfaces. We compare all four predictions with this same reference to obtain four MAEs and identify the lowest-error interface for each scenario. These errors provide the routing supervision, with soft targets and the near-best efficiency preference defined below. Thus, each task contributes 2,000 labeled chunk scenarios, not 8,000 independent training windows; all four interfaces are evaluated on every scenario rather than sampled as separate data sources. Using this 24-step, stride-one counting convention, sliding-window construction across the three task datasets yields up to 21,867,390 candidate windows in total. These overlapping windows are candidate chunk scenarios, not independent demonstrations. The 6,000 selected scenarios across the three tasks constitute approximately 0.0274% of this candidate pool (less than one thousandth). This fraction measures window sampling, not a reduction in episode acquisition requirements. PAIR is trained offline with the UniW(A)M backbone frozen. Final OOD success rates are measured in new physical robot trials rather than on windows held out from these episodes; the deployment environments do not exactly reproduce the dataset configurations, as detailed in Appendix C .

blocks.en: The eight heads are evaluated in parallel; their combined prediction and probability aggregation take approximately 2 ms in a separate measurement. To account for shared-expert feature computation and the remaining routing operations, we benchmark the first chunk of each window on a single NVIDIA H20 using checkpoint-150000 and an ensemble of eight router heads. After one warm-up window, we average five windows using synthetic 640 × \times 480 camera inputs and CUDA synchronization at each timing boundary. Subtracting the separately timed observation and language encoding stage from the complete observation-to-selection call gives 62.7 ms on average, rounded to 63 ms. This accounting includes input preparation, shared-expert feature computation, classification, and interface selection, but excludes observation and language encoding, subsequent action generation, cache reconstruction, and multi-GPU control communication. It characterizes the first-chunk setting rather than an average over chunk positions. The synthetic inputs are used to measure computation time, not routing accuracy.
blocks.zh: 八个头平行评价;它们的合并预测和概率汇总在单独的测量中大约需要2毫秒. 为了计算共享专家特性的计算和其余的路由操作,我们用1个NVIDIA H20和8个路由器头的组合,将每个窗口的第一个块作为基准。 经过一个热身窗口后,我们平均使用5个窗口,使用合成640×\times 480相机输入和CUDA同步,在每个计时边界. 将单独定时的观察和语言编码阶段从完整的观察对选调中分解,平均给出62.7 ms,四舍五入到63 ms. 这种核算包括输入准备,共享专家特性计算,分类,和界面选择,但不包括观察和语言编码,后续动作生成,缓存重建,以及多GPU控制通信. 其特征是第一弹头的设定,而不是平均超过块状位置。 合成输入用于测量计算时间,而不是路由精度.

blocks.en: B.3 Interface Selection across Execution Phases
blocks.zh: B.3 跨执行阶段的接口选择

blocks.en: Figure 12 reports phase-conditioned interface selection across the three real-world tasks. We divide execution into Reach, involving motion for approaching the target; Contact, involving contact-based manipulation; and Core, involving fine-grained manipulation, and measure each interface’s selection frequency within each phase. During Reach, Action-Only-WAM and Action-Centric-WAM together account for 60%–75% of selections, favoring fast action pathways for low-interaction motions. During Contact, the combined share of Joint-WAM and IDM-WAM rises to approximately 60%–70%, consistent with a preference for video-conditioned geometric guidance. During Core, these two interfaces account for 70%–90% of selections, indicating greater use of visual foresight during fine manipulation and complex physical interactions. This phase-dependent pattern is consistent with balancing fast action execution and foresight-rich control as interaction demands change, and offers an interpretation of the OOD gains reported in the main text. Examples of critical manipulation steps are discussed in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 图12报告三个现实世界任务的分阶段接口选择。 我们将执行分为“Reach ” , 涉及接近目标的动议; “接触” , 涉及基于联系的操纵; “核心”, 涉及精细的操纵, 并衡量每个接口在每个阶段的选择频率。 Action-Only-WAM和Action-Centric-WAM共占选题的60~75%, 在接触期间,联合-WAM和IDM-WAM的合并份额上升到约60~70%,这符合对视像条件几何制导的偏好. 期间 核心,这两个接口占选择量的70~~90%,表明在精细操纵和复杂的物理交互时,视觉展望被更多使用. 这种依赖阶段的模式与快速行动执行和在互动要求中富于远见的控制之间的平衡是一致的,并对正文中报告的OD收益作了解释。 关键操纵步骤的例子在附录D.2中讨论。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Phase-conditioned PAIR interface selection across three real-world tasks. Each panel reports 100%-stacked proportions for the Reach, Contact, and Core stages, revealing how the router shifts between fast action pathways and video-aware WAMs as interaction demands change.
blocks.zh: 图12:分阶段 PAIR接口选择涉及三个现实世界的任务. 每个小组都报告“到达”、“接触”和“核心”阶段100%的比例,揭示路由器在快速行动路径和视频意识WAM之间如何随着互动要求而变化。

blocks.en: Appendix C Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录C 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: We describe the benchmarks and evaluation protocols summarized in Section 4.1 . LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and the real-world tasks evaluate action generation, while WorldArena evaluates action-conditioned future-world prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们描述第4.1节概述的基准和评价协议。 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和现实世界的任务评价行动生成,而WorldArena则评价有行动条件的未来世界预测。

blocks.en: The benchmark comprises four official suites, including LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-Long, each containing 10 tasks with 50 demonstrations per task. We follow the standard public benchmarking protocol for training configurations and evaluation trial counts. We report task success rates for each suite alongside the overall average.
blocks.zh: 基准包括四个正式套房,包括LIBERO-SPATIAL,LIBERO-Object,LIBERO-GOAL,和LIBERO-Long,每个套房包含10项任务,每个任务50个演示. 我们遵循培训配置和评价试算的标准公共基准程序。 我们报告每个套房的任务成功率,同时报告总体平均数。

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0 evaluates dual-arm manipulation across 50 tasks. Following the official benchmark setting ( RoboTwin Team, 2026 ) , we jointly train a single policy on 50 clean demonstrations per task (2,500 demonstrations in total). We evaluate the same policy for 100 trials per task under clean (Clean-to-Clean, C2C) and randomized (Clean-to-Randomized, C2R) conditions, reporting the mean success rate across the 50 tasks separately for each setting. Baselines come from the official leaderboard snapshot updated on September 24, 2026. The π 0 \pi_{0} entry uses a separately fine-tuned checkpoint per task; the other listed baselines use co-training, which jointly trains one policy across all tasks.

Real-robot experiments are conducted on an AgileX dual-arm platform across three representative manipulation tasks: Folding Clothes , Folding Box , and Tabletop Cleaning . Each task is evaluated over 20 trials. All main comparisons and ablation studies share these three tasks, with task success rate serving as the primary evaluation metric. For PAIR, offline adaptation uses recorded OOD dataset episodes as described in Appendix B.1 , whereas final OOD evaluation consists of separately conducted real-robot deployments under environment configurations that do not exactly match those in the dataset. This evaluates transfer from offline target-domain data to physical execution; it is not a random window-level train/test split of the same recorded episodes.
blocks.zh: 在Agile上进行真正的机器人实验 X双臂平台跨越三个具有代表性的操纵任务:折叠衣物,折叠箱,以及表顶清洁. 每项任务都经过20多次审判。 所有主要的比较和消减研究都分担这三项任务,任务成功率是衡量主要评价的尺度。 就PAIR而言,离线适应使用附录B.1所述记录的OOD数据集事件,而最后OO评价则包括环境配置下单独进行的实际机器人部署,这些配置与数据集中的配置不完全一致。 此评价从离线目标域数据转移到物理执行; 这不是一个随机的窗口级列车/测试分拆相同的记录片段.

blocks.en: All interfaces use a configured denoising step count of 16. Joint-WAM jointly denoises video and actions for 16 steps, while Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM each denoise actions for 16 steps. IDM-WAM performs 16 video-denoising steps followed by 16 action-denoising steps. CFG is set to 5 for Joint-WAM and for IDM-WAM’s video stage; IDM-WAM’s action stage uses no CFG, and both fast interfaces use a guidance scale of 1. The standalone interface latency in Figure 5 (b) is the elapsed time for a complete action-chunk inference call divided by the configured step count of 16. For IDM-WAM, this denominator is 16 rather than the 32 iterations summed across its two stages. Multiplying each reported normalized latency by 16 recovers the corresponding full chunk inference time. Initial conditioning and cache construction performed within that call are included and amortized over the steps; the metric is not a direct measurement of a steady-state denoising iteration. PAIR routing is timed separately as described in Appendix B.2 . The task-level completion time in Figure 5 (a) is averaged over successful trials only. Failed and timed-out trials are excluded from this time average but remain in the success-rate denominator.

CFG被设定为联合-WAM和IDM-WAM的视频舞台5;IDM-WAM的动作舞台没有CFG,两个快速界面都使用1的制导尺度. 图5(b)中的独立接口延迟是完整的动作量推论呼叫的经过时间,除以配置的步数16. 对于IDM-WAM来说,这个分母是16个,而不是其两个阶段的32个重复。 将每个报告的正常时间乘以16,恢复相应的整块推断时间。 在该呼吁范围内进行的初步调节和缓存建造包括并分期摊还各个步骤;该衡量尺度不是对稳定状态去Noused迭代的直接衡量。 PAIR路由如附录B.2所述单独定时. 图5(a)中的任务完成时间平均只比成功的审判多。 失败和超时试验被排除在这一平均时间之外,但仍属于成功率分母。

blocks.en: To evaluate future world prediction, UniW(A)M operates as an action-conditioned world model following the standard WorldArena evaluation protocol. We report metrics across visual quality, motion quality, content consistency, physical adherence, 3D accuracy, and controllability, comparing against established action-conditioned video prediction baselines under the same benchmark protocol. This evaluation verifies whether unified multi-task training preserves action-conditioned world modeling capabilities.
blocks.zh: 为了评价未来的世界预测,UniW(A)M按照标准的世界阿雷纳评价协议作为行动条件的世界模型运作. 我们报告各种衡量标准,包括视觉质量、运动质量、内容一致性、物理坚持性、三维精度和可控性,与同一基准协议下设定的行动条件视频预测基线进行比较。 这一评估核实统一的多任务培训是否保留了具备行动条件的世界建模能力。

blocks.en: D.2 Case Study: Routing at Critical Manipulation Steps
blocks.zh: D.2 案例研究:关键操纵步骤的运行

blocks.en: Figure 16 illustrates why combining interfaces can benefit real-world task execution. A fixed interface may handle most of a trajectory well yet fail at a critical action. PAIR instead selects an interface for each execution chunk, aiming to exploit the different manipulation capabilities learned by the four interfaces. This allows the choice of action pathway to change with the current interaction, rather than relying on one interface throughout the task.
blocks.zh: 图16说明了为什么合并接口可以有利于现实世界的任务执行。 固定的接口可以处理大部分轨迹,但在关键的行动中却失败。 PAIR为每个执行块选择一个接口,目的是利用四个接口学到的不同操纵能力. 这使得选择行动路径能够随着当前互动的变化而改变,而不是依赖于整个任务过程中的一个接口.

blocks.en: Small execution errors can disrupt the entire folding sequence. From left to right, the five examples show failures to release the garment during the first, second, and final folding stages; a failed pull-back motion because the gripper does not contact the garment; and lifting the garment again to restart folding after a wrinkled intermediate result. The last behavior constitutes a renewed attempt rather than direct progress toward completion.
blocks.zh: 小执行错误可以扰乱整个折叠序列. 从左到右,五个例子显示在第一,第二,最后折叠阶段未能释放衣物;由于抓手不接触衣物,导致拉回运动失败;在皱纹中间结果后再次抬起衣物重新开始折叠. 最后的行为是一种新的尝试,而不是朝着完成的方向直接前进。

blocks.en: The examples highlight failures to push the left or right side flap into the intended position and complete the corresponding fold. Accurate contact placement and coordinated pushing are essential at these steps.

blocks.en: Table 14 summarizes the optimization settings for backbone training and PAIR adaptation. The backbone batch size is the effective global batch across devices and gradient accumulation. Each PAIR classification head is trained independently with a batch size of 128; this batch size is not multiplied by the number of ensemble members. The backbone weight decay applies to the decay parameter group, while parameters assigned to the no-decay group, including biases, use zero weight decay.

blocks.en: Table 15 compares a single dense DiT, MoE with sample-level routing, and UniW(A)M with CATR. All three use the same training steps, learning-rate settings, and training data volume. The single DiT is initialized from Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) . We report its approximate scale as 16.4B parameters based on the pretrained DiT, omitting the action/state adapters from this estimate. The MoE configurations use a Wan2.2-TI2V-5B backbone with five FFN experts per block and approximately 16.2B parameters. Both figures exclude external encoders and VAE. This is not a strictly parameter-matched comparison, and backbone configurations and initialization sources also differ. In contrast, sample-level routing and CATR use identical expert counts, network structures, and parameter counts. They differ in routing organization: CATR assigns eligible expert sets and learned mixture weights to modality- and role-specific token groups, whereas sample-level routing applies the active expert ensemble to the entire sample. This comparison evaluates the combined token-group routing design, rather than isolating pooling granularity alone.
blocks.zh: 表15比较了单一稠密的DiT,MOE与样品级路由,UniW(A)M与CATR. 三者都使用相同的培训步骤、学习率环境和培训数据量。 单DiT从Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P初始化 (Team Wan等人,2025年). 我们报告它的大致尺度是16.4B参数,以预先训练的DiT为基础,将动作/状态适配器从这个估计中省去. MOE配置采用Wan2.2-TI2V-5B主干,每块有5名FFN专家,约16.2B参数. 这两个数字不包括外部编码器和VAE. 这不是一个严格的参数匹配比较,骨干配置和初始化源也有所不同. 相比之下,样本级路由和CATR使用相同的专家计数,网络结构和参数计数. 它们在路由安排上有所不同:CATR将合格的专家集和学习过的混合物权重分配给模式和角色特定符号组,而样本级的路由则将活跃的专家综艺应用于整个样本. 这种比较评价了综合符号组的路由设计,而不是单独隔离集合颗粒.

blocks.en: The dense configuration reaches at most 16.7% average success. MoE with sample-level routing improves Joint-WAM and IDM-WAM to 51.7% and 60.0%, but both action-only inference pathways remain at 10.0%. CATR raises the four interfaces to 80.0%–88.3%, including 81.7% and 80.0% for Action-Centric-WAM and Action-Only-WAM. Thus, an expert architecture alone is insufficient to sustain all interfaces in this setting, while token-group alignment improves joint-training performance. These comparisons do not isolate the contributions of gradient interference or other optimization mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 密度配置平均达到16.7%。 具有样本级路径的教育部将联合-WAM和IDM-WAM改进为51.7%和60.0%,但两个仅行动推断路径仍保持在10.0%. CATR将4个接口提升至80.0%~88.3%,包括Action-Centric-WAM和Action-Only-WAM的81.7%和80.0%. 因此,仅靠一个专家架构不足以维持这一背景下的所有接口,而象征性的组合则能提高联合培训的绩效。 这些比较并不孤立梯度干扰或其他优化机制的贡献.

blocks.en: The four-WAM-only variant retains UniW(A)M with CATR but omits AC-WM from the training paradigm set. It uses the same initialization, total training steps, learning-rate settings, batch size, and dataset as the full five-paradigm model. Each retained interface is sampled with probability 0.25 0.25 , compared with 0.2 0.2 in the full model. Thus, the full model’s gains occur despite allocating fewer expected training updates to each WAM interface. As shown in Table 15 , its average success rates are 71.7%, 73.3%, 50.0%, and 36.7% for Joint-WAM, IDM-WAM, Action-Centric-WAM, and Action-Only-WAM, respectively, compared with 86.7%, 88.3%, 81.7%, and 80.0% under full five-paradigm training. Every interface–task pair improves when AC-WM is included. The largest task-level gains occur on box folding: Action-Centric-WAM increases from 30% to 75%, and Action-Only-WAM from 10% to 70%. These interfaces omit future-video prediction at deployment, so the observed benefit is not restricted to execution paths that explicitly generate visual rollouts. The comparison supports a positive contribution of AC-WM co-training to WAM action generation, while not isolating the optimization mechanism or establishing the reverse effect of WAM training on AC-WM quality.
blocks.zh: 四WAM的变体保留了UniW(A)M与CATR,但将AC-WM从培训范式集中省略. 它使用相同的初始化,总培训步骤,学习率设置,批量大小,以及数据集作为完整的五个参数模型. 每个保留接口的取样概率为0.250.25 ,而整个模型中的概率为0.2.2. 因此,尽管每个WAM接口的预期培训更新较少,但整个模型还是取得了进步。 如表15所示,它的平均成功率分别为71.7%、73.3%、50.0%和36.7%,而参加全面五边形培训的比例分别为86.7%、88.3%、81.7%和80.0%。 每个接口 - 任务对在包含AC- WM时都会改进. 最大的任务级别收益出现在盒式折叠上:行动-儿童-妇女行动计划从30%增加到75%,而行动-仅行动-妇女行动计划从10%增加到70%。 这些接口在部署时省略了未来-视频的预测,因此观察到的好处不仅限于明确产生视觉展开的执行路径. 比较支持AC-WM协同训练对WAM动作生成的积极贡献,同时不孤立优化机制或建立WAM训练对AC-WM质量的反效果.
